topic.angle: How many addresses fit in 32 bits

card.title: How many IPv4 addresses are there?

body.question: Every device on the internet needs an address. IPv4 uses 32 bits for it. About how many unique addresses is that?
body.reveal: 32 bits gives 4,294,967,296 unique addresses, about 4.3 billion, and large blocks of them are reserved for special purposes. That was not enough for the global internet.

probes.question: About how many unique addresses does IPv4's 32-bit address space provide?
True or false: IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long.
